    .testimonial-handle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .star { color: oklch(72% 0.15 60); font-size: 13px; }

    /* ===== CTA SECTION ===== */
    .cta-section {
      padding: 96px 24px 0;
      text-align: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cta-inner {
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      margin-bottom: 64px;
    }
    .cta-title {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .cta-subtitle {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .cta-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* App icon marquees */
    .app-marquees {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      padding: 32px 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .app-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .app-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      animation: marquee-left 25s linear infinite;
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .app-row:nth-child(2) .app-track {
      animation: marquee-right 28s linear infinite;
    }
    .app-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      padding: 56px 24px 32px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .footer-brand {}
    .footer-logo {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      text-decoration: none;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .footer-logo span { color: var(--accent); }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 240px;
    }
    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-links { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copy { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .footer-copy a { color: var(--text-tertiary); text-decoration: none; }
    .footer-copy a:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); text-decoration: underline; }
    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .footer-legal a:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); text-decoration: underline; }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .hero-screen-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
      .hero-screen-card:last-child { display: none; }
      .features-flows-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .hero { padding: 64px 20px 56px; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .nav-mobile-toggle { display: block; }
      .nav-cta-mobile { display: none; }
      .hero-screen-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .hero-screen-card:nth-child(n+4) { display: none; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
      .screenshot-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .flows-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .ui-elements-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .text-results { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .hero h1 { font-size: 36px; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .hero-screen-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .hero-screen-card:nth-child(n+3) { display: none; }
      .screenshot-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .flows-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .text-results { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .testimonial-card { min-width: 280px; }
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE MENU ===== */
    .mobile-menu {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      z-index: 200;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .mobile-menu.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-menu-header {

    .mobile-menu-close {
      background: none;

      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .mobile-menu-links {
      list-style: none;

      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .mobile-menu-links a {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 12px;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }
    .mobile-menu-links a:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); }

    /* Decorative color helpers for mock screens */
    .c1 { background: oklch(72% 0.12 265); }
    .c2 { background: oklch(78% 0.09 210); }
    .c3 { background: oklch(82% 0.1 160); }

    .cs { background: var(--bg-surface); }

    .cw { background: var(--bg); }
    .ca { background: var(--accent); }
    .cm { background: oklch(50% 0.15 265); }
  </style>
</head>

  function animateCount(el, target, duration) {
    let start = 0;
    const step = timestamp => {
      if (!start) start = timestamp;
      const progress = Math.min((timestamp - start) / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3); // ease-out cubic
      el.textContent = formatNumber(Math.floor(eased * target));
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else el.textContent = formatNumber(target);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(step);

          const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
          setTimeout(() => animateCount(el, target, 1800), i * 220);

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .btn-secondary {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding: 13px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: var(--transition);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--text-primary); border-color: oklch(75% 0.01 265); background: var(--bg-subtle); }

    /* Hero screenshot grid preview */
    .hero-visual {
      margin-top: 56px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-screen-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .hero-screen-card {
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-screen-card .screen-mock {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 10px 8px;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .screen-header { height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; }
    .screen-body { flex: 1; border-radius: 6px; }
    .screen-footer { height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; }

    /* ===== TRUSTED BY ===== */
    .trusted-by {
      padding: 56px 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .trusted-by-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .trusted-logos {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 40px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .trusted-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      filter: grayscale(1);
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .trusted-logo:hover { opacity: 0.75; filter: grayscale(0); }
    .trusted-logo svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    /* ===== STATS ===== */
    .stats {
      padding: 80px 24px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
    }
    .stats-inner {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .stats-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: oklch(65% 0.01 265);
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
    }
    .stat-item {}
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--bg);
    }
    .stat-number .accent { color: oklch(70% 0.2 265); }
    .stat-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: oklch(60% 0.01 265);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ===== SECTION COMMON ===== */
    .section {
      padding: 96px 24px;
    }
    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .section-tag {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURE: SEARCH ===== */
    .features-search { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
    .search-header { margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .search-widget {
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .search-widget-top {
      padding: 20px 24px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .search-input-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .search-box {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 11px 16px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      outline: none;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .search-box:focus { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--bg); }
    .search-box::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .search-btn {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 11px 20px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font);
      transition: var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .search-btn:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); }

    /* Tabs */
    .search-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
    }
    .tab-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font);
      transition: var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .tab-btn.active {
      color: var(--accent);
      border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Filter Pills */
    .filter-pills-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .filter-pills-row::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .pill {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: var(--transition);
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .pill:hover { border-color: oklch(75% 0.01 265); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .pill.active {
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-color: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Screenshot grid */
    .screenshot-grid {
      padding: 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
      min-height: 280px;
    }
    .screenshot-card {
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .screenshot-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .screenshot-card .inner {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 8px 6px;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    /* Tab content panels */
    .tab-panel { display: none; }
    .tab-panel.active { display: block; }

    /* UI Elements panel */
    .ui-elements-grid {
      padding: 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .ui-el-card {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 20px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .ui-el-tag {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }
    .ui-el-preview {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* Flows panel */
    .flows-grid {
      padding: 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .flow-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .flow-header {
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .flow-screens {
      display: flex;
      padding: 10px;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .flow-screen-mini {
      flex: 1;
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }
    .flow-count {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }

    /* Text in screenshot panel */
    .text-panel {
      padding: 24px;
    }
    .text-search-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .text-search-box {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      outline: none;
    }
    .text-results {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .text-result-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-light);
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      position: relative;
    }
    .text-result-highlight {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 20%;
      left: 10%;
      right: 10%;
      background: oklch(88% 0.14 90 / 0.9);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: oklch(30% 0.08 90);
    }

    /* ===== FEATURE: FLOWS ===== */
    .features-flows-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .flows-toggle-row {
      display: flex;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 4px;
      gap: 4px;
      width: fit-content;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .toggle-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 18px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .toggle-btn.active {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-weight: 600;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .flows-mode-content { display: none; }
    .flows-mode-content.active { display: block; }
    .flows-feature-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .flows-feature-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--accent-soft);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .flows-feature-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .flows-feature-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .flows-feature-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .flows-visual {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .flows-visual-videos {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .video-card {
      flex: 1;
      aspect-ratio: 9/19;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      background: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .video-play-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.15);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .video-play-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: #fff; margin-left: 2px; }
    .flows-visual-proto {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .proto-screen {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .proto-main {
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      position: relative;
    }
    .proto-hotspot {
      position: absolute;
      border: 2px solid var(--accent);
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: oklch(55% 0.22 265 / 0.1);
      animation: hotspot-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes hotspot-pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; }
    }
    .proto-steps {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px;
    }
    .proto-step-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--border);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 5px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .proto-step-dot.active { background: var(--accent); }
    .proto-step-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    /* ===== FEATURE: TOOLS ===== */
    .features-tools { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
    .tools-header { margin-bottom: 56px; }
    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .tool-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .tool-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .tool-visual {
      padding: 24px 24px 0;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      overflow: hidden;
      height: 200px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
    }
    .tool-info {
      padding: 24px;
    }
    .tool-title {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .tool-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Figma mock */
    .figma-mock {
      width: 100%;
      background: oklch(20% 0.01 265);
      border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .figma-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .figma-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }
    .figma-canvas {
      background: oklch(30% 0.01 265);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .figma-frame {
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: 4px;
      flex: 1;
      aspect-ratio: 9/14;
    }

    /* Collections mock */
    .collections-mock {
      width: 100%;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .coll-card {
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    /* Comments mock */
    .comments-mock {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .comment-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .comment-avatar {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .comment-bubble {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 6px 10px;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .comment-name { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .comment-text { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); }

    /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
    .testimonials { overflow: hidden; padding: 96px 0; }
    .testimonials-header {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 24px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .marquee-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .marquee-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .marquee-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      animation: marquee-left 35s linear infinite;
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .marquee-row:nth-child(2) .marquee-track {
      animation: marquee-right 40s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes marquee-left {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    @keyframes marquee-right {
      0% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
      100% { transform: translateX(0); }
    }
    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      min-width: 340px;
      max-width: 340px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .testimonial-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .testimonial-handle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .star { color: oklch(72% 0.15 60); font-size: 13px; }

    /* ===== CTA SECTION ===== */
    .cta-section {
      padding: 96px 24px 0;
      text-align: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cta-inner {
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      margin-bottom: 64px;
    }
    .cta-title {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .cta-subtitle {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .cta-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* App icon marquees */
    .app-marquees {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      padding: 32px 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .app-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .app-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      animation: marquee-left 25s linear infinite;
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .app-row:nth-child(2) .app-track {
      animation: marquee-right 28s linear infinite;
    }
    .app-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      padding: 56px 24px 32px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .footer-brand {}
    .footer-logo {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      text-decoration: none;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .footer-logo span { color: var(--accent); }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 240px;
    }
    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

<script>
  // ===== Mobile menu =====
  const toggle = document.getElementById('mobileToggle');
  const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
  const close = document.getElementById('mobileClose');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => menu.classList.add('open'));
  close.addEventListener('click', () => menu.classList.remove('open'));

  // ===== Stats counter =====
  function formatNumber(n) {
    return n.toLocaleString('en-US');
  }
  function animateCount(el, target, duration) {
    let start = 0;
    const step = timestamp => {
      if (!start) start = timestamp;
      const progress = Math.min((timestamp - start) / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3); // ease-out cubic
      el.textContent = formatNumber(Math.floor(eased * target));
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else el.textContent = formatNumber(target);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  let statsAnimated = false;
  const statsSection = document.getElementById('stats');
  const statCounts = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-count');

  const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting && !statsAnimated) {
        statsAnimated = true;
        statCounts.forEach((el, i) => {
          const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
          setTimeout(() => animateCount(el, target, 1800), i * 220);
        });
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.4 });
  statsObserver.observe(statsSection);

  // ===== Search tabs =====
  const tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
  const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');
  tabBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tabBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      tabPanels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('panel-' + btn.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // ===== Filter pills =====
  const pills = document.querySelectorAll('.pill');
  pills.forEach(pill => {
    pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
      pills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      pill.classList.add('active');
      renderScreenshots(pill.dataset.filter);
    });
  });

  // ===== Screenshot grid generator =====

      ['oklch(96% 0.02 300)', 'oklch(58% 0.2 300)', 'oklch(90% 0.04 300)'],

    'Wallet': [

      ? (app.bg.includes('265') || app.bg.includes('300') || app.bg.includes('10') ? '#fff' : '#fff')

    return `<div class="app-icon" style="background:${app.bg};color:#fff;font-size:10px;">${short}</div>`;

  function fillAppRow(id, items) {

  fillAppRow('appRow1', appIcons);

  // Pause marquees on hover
  document.querySelectorAll('.marquee-row, .app-row').forEach(row => {

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>ScreenVault — UI & UX Design Inspiration Library</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Save hours of UI & UX research with a library of 400,000+ fully searchable mobile & web app screenshots." />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --bg: oklch(100% 0 0);
      --bg-subtle: oklch(97% 0.003 265);
      --bg-surface: oklch(95% 0.005 265);
      --border: oklch(90% 0.005 265);
      --border-light: oklch(94% 0.003 265);
      --text-primary: oklch(12% 0.01 265);
      --text-secondary: oklch(42% 0.01 265);
      --text-tertiary: oklch(62% 0.01 265);
      --accent: oklch(55% 0.22 265);
      --accent-hover: oklch(48% 0.22 265);
      --accent-soft: oklch(92% 0.08 265);
      --accent-text: oklch(55% 0.22 265);
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.04);
      --shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.07), 0 2px 6px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.04);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 32px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 12px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.06);
      --font: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --transition: 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* ===== ANNOUNCEMENT BAR ===== */
    .announcement-bar {
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    }
    .announcement-bar a {
      color: oklch(80% 0.12 265);
      text-decoration: none;
      margin-left: 6px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .announcement-bar a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    /* ===== NAVIGATION ===== */
    .nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 60px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .nav-logo {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .nav-logo span { color: var(--accent); }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-subtle); }
    .nav-cta {
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg) !important;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm) !important;
      font-weight: 600 !important;
    }
    .nav-cta:hover { background: oklch(20% 0.01 265) !important; color: var(--bg) !important; }
    .nav-mobile-toggle {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 6px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      padding: 96px 24px 80px;
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--accent-soft);
      color: var(--accent-text);
      border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.1 265);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 5px 14px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(0.85); }
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(40px, 7vw, 72px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero h1 em {
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 19px);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 540px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }
    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 13px 28px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: var(--transition);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .btn-secondary {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding: 13px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: var(--transition);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--text-primary); border-color: oklch(75% 0.01 265); background: var(--bg-subtle); }

    /* Hero screenshot grid preview */
    .hero-visual {
      margin-top: 56px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-screen-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .hero-screen-card {
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-screen-card .screen-mock {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 10px 8px;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .screen-header { height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; }
    .screen-body { flex: 1; border-radius: 6px; }
    .screen-footer { height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; }

    /* ===== TRUSTED BY ===== */
    .trusted-by {
      padding: 56px 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .trusted-by-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .trusted-logos {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 40px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .trusted-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      filter: grayscale(1);
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .trusted-logo:hover { opacity: 0.75; filter: grayscale(0); }
    .trusted-logo svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    /* ===== STATS ===== */
    .stats {
      padding: 80px 24px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
    }
    .stats-inner {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .stats-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: oklch(65% 0.01 265);
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
    }
    .stat-item {}
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--bg);
    }
    .stat-number .accent { color: oklch(70% 0.2 265); }
    .stat-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: oklch(60% 0.01 265);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ===== SECTION COMMON ===== */
    .section {
      padding: 96px 24px;
    }
    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .section-tag {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURE: SEARCH ===== */
    .features-search { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
    .search-header { margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .search-widget {
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .search-widget-top {
      padding: 20px 24px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .search-input-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .search-box {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 11px 16px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      outline: none;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .search-box:focus { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--bg); }
    .search-box::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .search-btn {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 11px 20px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font);
      transition: var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .search-btn:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); }

    /* Tabs */
    .search-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
    }
    .tab-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font);
      transition: var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .tab-btn.active {
      color: var(--accent);
      border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Filter Pills */
    .filter-pills-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .filter-pills-row::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .pill {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: var(--transition);
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .pill:hover { border-color: oklch(75% 0.01 265); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .pill.active {
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-color: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--bg);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Screenshot grid */
    .screenshot-grid {
      padding: 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
      min-height: 280px;
    }
    .screenshot-card {
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .screenshot-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .screenshot-card .inner {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 8px 6px;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    /* Tab content panels */
    .tab-panel { display: none; }
    .tab-panel.active { display: block; }

    /* UI Elements panel */
    .ui-elements-grid {
      padding: 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .ui-el-card {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 20px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .ui-el-tag {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }
    .ui-el-preview {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* Flows panel */
    .flows-grid {
      padding: 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .flow-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .flow-header {
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .flow-screens {
      display: flex;
      padding: 10px;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .flow-screen-mini {
      flex: 1;
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }
    .flow-count {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }

    /* Text in screenshot panel */
    .text-panel {
      padding: 24px;
    }
    .text-search-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .text-search-box {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      outline: none;
    }
    .text-results {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .text-result-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-light);
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      position: relative;
    }
    .text-result-highlight {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 20%;
      left: 10%;
      right: 10%;
      background: oklch(88% 0.14 90 / 0.9);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: oklch(30% 0.08 90);
    }

    /* ===== FEATURE: FLOWS ===== */
    .features-flows-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .flows-toggle-row {
      display: flex;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 4px;
      gap: 4px;
      width: fit-content;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .toggle-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 18px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .toggle-btn.active {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-weight: 600;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .flows-mode-content { display: none; }
    .flows-mode-content.active { display: block; }
    .flows-feature-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .flows-feature-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--accent-soft);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .flows-feature-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .flows-feature-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .flows-feature-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .flows-visual {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .flows-visual-videos {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .video-card {
      flex: 1;
      aspect-ratio: 9/19;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      background: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .video-play-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.15);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .video-play-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: #fff; margin-left: 2px; }
    .flows-visual-proto {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .proto-screen {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .proto-main {
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      position: relative;
    }
    .proto-hotspot {
      position: absolute;
      border: 2px solid var(--accent);
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: oklch(55% 0.22 265 / 0.1);
      animation: hotspot-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes hotspot-pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; }
    }
    .proto-steps {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px;
    }
    .proto-step-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--border);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 5px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .proto-step-dot.active { background: var(--accent); }
    .proto-step-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    /* ===== FEATURE: TOOLS ===== */
    .features-tools { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
    .tools-header { margin-bottom: 56px; }
    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .tool-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .tool-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .tool-visual {
      padding: 24px 24px 0;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      overflow: hidden;
      height: 200px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
    }
    .tool-info {
      padding: 24px;
    }
    .tool-title {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .tool-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Figma mock */
    .figma-mock {
      width: 100%;
      background: oklch(20% 0.01 265);
      border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .figma-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .figma-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }
    .figma-canvas {
      background: oklch(30% 0.01 265);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .figma-frame {
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: 4px;
      flex: 1;
      aspect-ratio: 9/14;
    }

    /* Collections mock */
    .collections-mock {
      width: 100%;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .coll-card {
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    /* Comments mock */
    .comments-mock {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .comment-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .comment-avatar {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .comment-bubble {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 6px 10px;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .comment-name { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .comment-text { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); }

    /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
    .testimonials { overflow: hidden; padding: 96px 0; }
    .testimonials-header {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 24px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .marquee-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .marquee-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .marquee-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      animation: marquee-left 35s linear infinite;
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .marquee-row:nth-child(2) .marquee-track {
      animation: marquee-right 40s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes marquee-left {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    @keyframes marquee-right {
      0% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
      100% { transform: translateX(0); }
    }
    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      min-width: 340px;
      max-width: 340px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .testimonial-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .testimonial-handle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .star { color: oklch(72% 0.15 60); font-size: 13px; }

    /* ===== CTA SECTION ===== */
    .cta-section {
      padding: 96px 24px 0;
      text-align: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cta-inner {
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      margin-bottom: 64px;
    }
    .cta-title {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .cta-subtitle {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .cta-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* App icon marquees */
    .app-marquees {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      padding: 32px 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .app-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .app-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      animation: marquee-left 25s linear infinite;
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .app-row:nth-child(2) .app-track {
      animation: marquee-right 28s linear infinite;
    }
    .app-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      padding: 56px 24px 32px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .footer-brand {}
    .footer-logo {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      text-decoration: none;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .footer-logo span { color: var(--accent); }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 240px;
    }
    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-links { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copy { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .footer-copy a { color: var(--text-tertiary); text-decoration: none; }
    .footer-copy a:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); text-decoration: underline; }
    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .footer-legal a:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); text-decoration: underline; }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .hero-screen-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
      .hero-screen-card:last-child { display: none; }
      .features-flows-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .hero { padding: 64px 20px 56px; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .nav-mobile-toggle { display: block; }
      .nav-cta-mobile { display: none; }
      .hero-screen-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .hero-screen-card:nth-child(n+4) { display: none; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
      .screenshot-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .flows-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .ui-elements-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .text-results { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .hero h1 { font-size: 36px; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .hero-screen-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .hero-screen-card:nth-child(n+3) { display: none; }
      .screenshot-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .flows-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .text-results { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .testimonial-card { min-width: 280px; }
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE MENU ===== */
    .mobile-menu {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      z-index: 200;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .mobile-menu.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-menu-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .mobile-menu-close {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 6px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .mobile-menu-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .mobile-menu-links a {
      display: block;

<script>
  // ===== Mobile menu =====
  const toggle = document.getElementById('mobileToggle');
  const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
  const close = document.getElementById('mobileClose');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => menu.classList.add('open'));
  close.addEventListener('click', () => menu.classList.remove('open'));

  // ===== Stats counter =====
  function formatNumber(n) {
    return n.toLocaleString('en-US');
  }
  function animateCount(el, target, duration) {
    let start = 0;
    const step = timestamp => {
      if (!start) start = timestamp;
      const progress = Math.min((timestamp - start) / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3); // ease-out cubic
      el.textContent = formatNumber(Math.floor(eased * target));
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else el.textContent = formatNumber(target);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  let statsAnimated = false;
  const statsSection = document.getElementById('stats');
  const statCounts = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-count');

  const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting && !statsAnimated) {
        statsAnimated = true;
        statCounts.forEach((el, i) => {
          const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
          setTimeout(() => animateCount(el, target, 1800), i * 220);
        });
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.4 });
  statsObserver.observe(statsSection);

  // ===== Search tabs =====
  const tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
  const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');
  tabBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tabBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      tabPanels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('panel-' + btn.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // ===== Filter pills =====

      ['oklch(98% 0.01 60)', 'oklch(68% 0.18 60)', 'oklch(91% 0.04 60)'],
    ],
  };

  function makeScreenCard(palette) {
    const [bg, accent, secondary] = palette;
    return `<div class="screenshot-card" style="background:${bg}">
      <div class="inner">
        <div style="height:24px;border-radius:6px;background:${secondary}"></div>
        <div style="flex:1;border-radius:6px;background:${secondary};display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:7px;">
          <div style="height:36px;border-radius:5px;background:${bg};opacity:0.6;"></div>
          <div style="height:7px;width:78%;border-radius:3px;background:${bg};opacity:0.35;"></div>
          <div style="height:7px;width:55%;border-radius:3px;background:${bg};opacity:0.25;"></div>
          <div style="margin-top:5px;height:24px;border-radius:5px;background:${accent};"></div>
        </div>
        <div style="height:18px;border-radius:6px;background:${secondary}"></div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }

  function renderScreenshots(filter) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('screensGrid');
    const palettes = screenPalettes[filter] || screenPalettes['Login'];
    grid.innerHTML = palettes.map(p => makeScreenCard(p)).join('');
  }
  renderScreenshots('Login');

  // Build flows grid
  function buildFlowsGrid() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('flowsGrid');
    const flowData = [
      { name: 'Onboarding', screens: 5, colors: ['oklch(55% 0.22 265)', 'oklch(78% 0.14 265)', 'oklch(42% 0.2 265)'] },
      { name: 'Login & Auth', screens: 4, colors: ['oklch(14% 0.01 265)', 'oklch(30% 0.03 265)', 'oklch(22% 0.02 265)'] },
      { name: 'Checkout', screens: 6, colors: ['oklch(65% 0.18 30)', 'oklch(80% 0.12 30)', 'oklch(52% 0.16 30)'] },
    ];
    grid.innerHTML = flowData.map(f => `
      <div class="flow-card">
        <div class="flow-header">
          <span>${f.name}</span>
          <span class="flow-count">${f.screens} screens</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flow-screens">
          ${f.colors.map(c => `<div class="flow-screen-mini" style="background:${c}"></div>`).join('')}
          <div class="flow-screen-mini" style="background:var(--bg-surface);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-tertiary);font-weight:600;">+${f.screens - f.colors.length}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }
  buildFlowsGrid();

  // Build text results
  function buildTextResults() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('textResults');
    const colors = [
      'oklch(98% 0.01 265)', 'oklch(14% 0.01 265)', 'oklch(96% 0.03 30)', 'oklch(18% 0.04 265)'
    ];
    grid.innerHTML = colors.map((bg, i) => `
      <div class="text-result-card" style="background:${bg}">
        <div style="position:absolute;inset:0;padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;">
          <div style="height:20px;border-radius:5px;background:oklch(${i%2===0?'90%':'25%'} 0.02 265)"></div>
          <div style="flex:1;border-radius:5px;background:oklch(${i%2===0?'93%':'22%'} 0.02 265)"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="text-result-highlight">Get started</div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }
  buildTextResults();

  // ===== Flows mode toggle =====
  const toggleBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn');
  toggleBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      toggleBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      const mode = btn.dataset.mode;
      document.querySelectorAll('.flows-mode-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      document.getElementById('mode-' + mode).classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('visual-videos').style.display = mode === 'videos' ? 'flex' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('visual-prototype').style.display = mode === 'prototype' ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
  });

  // ===== Testimonials marquee =====
  const testimonials = [
    { name: 'Sebastian Speier', org: 'Shop', initials: 'SS', color: 'oklch(65% 0.18 265)', text: 'ScreenVault is a great resource and it always comes in handy to see what the best practices or standards are for mobile patterns in our current landscape.' },
    { name: 'Meng To', org: 'DesignCode', initials: 'MT', color: 'oklch(60% 0.2 160)', text: "ScreenVault is a game-changer for designers looking to step up their understanding of UX and UI design patterns. It's so massive, meticulously organized, has deep user flows and even a Figma plugin! It's indispensable in the modern designer's toolbox." },
    { name: 'Marco Cornacchia', org: 'Figma', initials: 'MC', color: 'oklch(62% 0.18 300)', text: "ScreenVault is one of my favorite resources for product design and UI inspo. I love having access to a ton of 'real world examples' to see how different apps and companies handle specific UI patterns and flows." },
    { name: 'Daryl Ginn', org: 'Endless', initials: 'DG', color: 'oklch(68% 0.16 30)', text: 'ScreenVault has quickly become our favourite inspiration resource for designing mobile apps at endless.design, their advanced filtering is unmatched in the inspiration space.' },
    { name: 'Rachel How', org: '', initials: 'RH', color: 'oklch(65% 0.17 80)', text: 'ScreenVault is my go-to reference for app & web design. Apart from saving countless hours, it gives me insights on the design patterns, copywriting, and user flows of world-class products. A must-have for creative inspiration and efficiency!' },
    { name: 'Haerin Song', org: 'Visa', initials: 'HS', color: 'oklch(55% 0.22 265)', text: 'By using the ScreenVault app, I save both my research time and space in my photo galleries filled with random screenshots. I love how easy it is to search for different patterns and copy and paste flows into Figma. It is a wonderful design tool you cannot live without!' },
  ];

  function makeTestimonialCard(t) {
    return `<div class="testimonial-card">
      <div class="testimonial-stars">${'<span class="star">★</span>'.repeat(5)}</div>
      <p class="testimonial-quote">"${t.text}"</p>
      <div class="testimonial-author">
        <div class="testimonial-avatar" style="background:${t.color};color:#fff">${t.initials}</div>
        <div>
          <div class="testimonial-name">${t.name}</div>
          ${t.org ? `<div class="testimonial-handle">${t.org}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }

  function fillMarqueeRow(id, items) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    // Duplicate for seamless loop
    const html = [...items, ...items].map(makeTestimonialCard).join('');
    el.innerHTML = html;
  }

  fillMarqueeRow('marqueeRow1', testimonials);
  fillMarqueeRow('marqueeRow2', testimonials.slice().reverse());

  // ===== App icon marquee =====
  const appIcons = [
    { label: 'Coinbase', bg: 'oklch(58% 0.2 265)' },
    { label: 'Wise', bg: 'oklch(65% 0.18 160)' },
    { label: 'Headspace', bg: 'oklch(60% 0.18 30)' },
    { label: 'Airbnb', bg: 'oklch(60% 0.2 10)' },
    { label: 'Uber', bg: 'oklch(15% 0.01 265)' },
    { label: 'Nike', bg: 'oklch(18% 0.01 265)' },
    { label: 'Pinterest', bg: 'oklch(55% 0.22 10)' },
    { label: 'ChatGPT', bg: 'oklch(50% 0.18 160)' },
    { label: 'Shopify', bg: 'oklch(55% 0.18 155)' },
    { label: 'Loom', bg: 'oklch(55% 0.22 10)' },
    { label: 'Mailchimp', bg: 'oklch(72% 0.18 80)' },
    { label: 'Twitch', bg: 'oklch(52% 0.22 300)' },
    { label: 'Spotify', bg: 'oklch(60% 0.2 155)' },
    { label: 'Apple TV', bg: 'oklch(15% 0.01 265)' },
    { label: 'Notion', bg: 'oklch(14% 0.01 265)' },
    { label: 'Dropbox', bg: 'oklch(55% 0.22 265)' },
  ];

  function makeAppIcon(app) {
    const short = app.label.split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').slice(0, 2);
    const textColor = app.bg.includes('oklch(1') || app.bg.includes('oklch(7') || app.bg.includes('oklch(6') || app.bg.includes('oklch(5')
      ? (app.bg.includes('265') || app.bg.includes('300') || app.bg.includes('10') ? '#fff' : '#fff')
      : '#fff';
    return `<div class="app-icon" style="background:${app.bg};color:#fff;font-size:10px;">${short}</div>`;
  }

  function fillAppRow(id, items) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.innerHTML = [...items, ...items].map(makeAppIcon).join('');
  }

  fillAppRow('appRow1', appIcons);
  fillAppRow('appRow2', appIcons.slice().reverse());

  // Pause marquees on hover
  document.querySelectorAll('.marquee-row, .app-row').forEach(row => {
    row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      row.querySelectorAll('.marquee-track, .app-track').forEach(t => t.style.animationPlayState = 'paused');
    });
    row.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      row.querySelectorAll('.marquee-track, .app-track').forEach(t => t.style.animationPlayState = 'running');
    });
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>

The ScreenVault landing page is complete at `/app/output/index.html` (82KB, 2149 lines). Here's what was built:

- **Feature: Search** — full search widget with 4 interactive tabs (Screens / UI Elements / Flows / Text in Screenshot) + 10 filter pills that dynamically recolor the screenshot grid
- **Feature: Flows** — two-column layout with Videos/Prototype toggle switching both the text and the visual mockup
- **Feature: Tools** — 3 cards with detailed mocks for Figma plugin, Collections, and Comments
- **Testimonials** — dual-row continuous marquee (opposite directions), pauses on hover
- **CTA** — headline + dual CTAs above dual app-icon marquees in alternating directions
- **Footer** — 4-column grid with all links from the brief

**Design system:** OKLCH color palette, Inter typeface, 220ms cubic-bezier transitions, responsive at 1024/768/480px breakpoints, zero build step required.
